svg.title: The farming axis across a working landscape
svg.desc: A block diagram of rolling farmland cut by a stream, with three farmsteads, a section-road grid, a substation, and a small town with a water tower. Arrays sit in eight places, each outlined in the color of its farming-axis position. S0: a closed landfill cap at the town edge, grazed under the array. S1: a sheep pasture that stays a pasture under the rows. S2: a corn field turned to grazing under an array. S3: a whole ordinary field taken beside the substation and mown. S4: two rows along a road edge, and a small array on an eroded knoll. S5: rows on the shoulders of a grassed waterway in a soybean field, and rows set in a prairie strip on the contour above the stream.
